What scattered data costs today

  • The weekly spreadsheet Someone exports, pastes and fixes the same report every week.
  • Three versions of a customer The same person spelled three ways across three systems.
  • Data you rent Your history lives in vendors' clouds, on their terms.
  • Nothing for AI to stand on Agents are only as good as the data they can read.

What we build

Built in accounts you own. The agent drafts, checks, or flags; a person makes the call.

  1. A warehouse in your account Your data in open formats such as Postgres, in a cloud account you own.
  2. Connectors to your tools Pulls from accounting, CRM, payments, scheduling and project tools, then cleans and matches records.
  3. Reports that rebuild themselves The numbers you check every week, refreshed on their own and consistent across tools.

Built so you are never stuck

You own it
The data, code, and credentials live in accounts you control.
You can leave
Open formats and written documentation mean anyone can take over without a rebuild.
You can see what agents did
Every action is recorded: what it read, what it proposed, and who approved it.
You choose the AI
Nothing is tied to one model provider. You decide which models see what.

How it starts

  1. 01 A call about one task Tell us the job that eats your week and the tools it touches. We will say plainly whether it is worth building.
  2. 02 Build it in your accounts We set up the data and connections in accounts you own, starting with the tools that task needs.
  3. 03 Run it with a person in charge The agent drafts, checks, or flags. Someone on your team approves anything that matters.
  4. 04 Hand over You get the code, the documentation, and the access. Keep us on for support, or don't.
